purpose: Prevent validation theater by defining which evidence can promote Mega Drive/SGDK claims across documentation, implementation, build, emulator, VDP and AAA-readiness states.
global_rules: A text report is never runtime evidence.
Build success is never emulator validation.
A screenshot is visual evidence only for the visible frame, not proof of performance, memory budget or full asset fidelity.
A failed or partial visual asset can be negative evidence, comparison evidence or runtime placeholder evidence, but never generation source truth.
The highest claim allowed is the lowest proven rung across code, art, hardware budget, audio and evidence.

rungs.meaning: The technique, asset or plan exists only as documentation or prompt intent.
insufficient_evidence: agent statement that implementation is straightforward

rungs.meaning: The work has a concrete SGDK/Mega Drive contract, inputs, outputs, blockers and handoffs.
Code, asset, script or resource file exists in the project tree.
insufficient_evidence: generated art not copied into project source truth

rungs.meaning: The project builds and produces the expected ROM or generated asset output.
minimum_evidence: resource validation clean when resources changed
insufficient_evidence: build log not tied to current worktree

rungs.meaning: The ROM or runtime scene was observed in the required emulator with traceable evidence.
minimum_evidence: basic gameplay or visual behavior observed
insufficient_evidence: BizHawk-only evidence when BlastEm is required

rungs.meaning: Hardware budget claims are backed by VDP/VRAM/CRAM/SAT/DMA or equivalent evidence.
minimum_evidence: VDP or visual dump when required
scanline or sprite risk addressed when relevant
insufficient_evidence: palette claim without indexed or CRAM evidence

rungs.meaning: The work has passed relevant domain gates and has sufficient emulator/VDP evidence to be reviewed as AAA candidate.
minimum_evidence: human visual review when AAA visual quality is claimed
BlastEm/VDP evidence package when runtime visuals are claimed
insufficient_evidence: all green text report without artifacts
partial candidate with missing visual review
missing VDP dump when the project declares it required

extra_requirements: approved model sheet source of truth
obsolete rejected sheets excluded from generation sources
VDP evidence when runtime visual behavior is claimed
